crossRefs.note: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
translations.bsb: And when Abimelech was told that all the leaders in the tower of Shechem were gathered there,
translations.kjv: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
translations.asv: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
